item.title: 动态热激励下用于锂离子电池荷电状态估计的热关系状态推断
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Yicheng Li, Hui Zeng, Jiayan Xia, Yaqing Shi, Pin Liu
动态热激励下，端部测量量与潜在荷电状态之间的时变关系增加了SOC估计的复杂性。本文提出热关系状态推断网络TRSI-Net，将SOC估计建模为热条件关系推断，并通过热条件仿射重校准、热关系场和热关系记忆注意力组织历史信息。在Panasonic NCR18650PF数据集上，该方法取得0.47%的MAE、0.56%的RMSE和99.94%的R²，相较最强基线分别将MAE和RMSE降低62.1%和65.0%。

item.title: 物理信息符号回归揭示了粒子—界面动力学中的延迟振荡闭合关系
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Teddy Lazebnik, Chen Mortenfeld, Alex Liberzon
研究利用物理信息符号回归分析分层流体中颗粒穿越尖锐密度界面的高分辨率跟踪实验数据，建立了描述延迟分层诱导力的紧凑解析闭合关系。该闭合关系表现为延迟的指数衰减振荡形式，可捕捉界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫等机制，并在瞬态丰富的情形下优于基于虚质量方程的模型。研究表明，结合时间序列实验数据、量纲约束和物理约束的符号回归能够辅助复杂流体动力学中的可解释模型发现。

item.title: X-ray absorption and resonant x-ray emission at the carbon edge of Li 2 CO 3
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
While highly successful, density functional theory is known to have limitations owing to its neglect of many-body electron–electron interactions. This neglect leads to errors in the single-particle energies, leading to underestimated bandgaps and bandwidths as well as errors in band alignment at interfaces. Many-body perturbation theory, in the form of the GW self-energy correction, has been widely used to improve upon these shortcomings. Although less well studied, the same GW method is also able to predict the finite quasiparticle lifetime that is seen to cause anomalous broadening in the lowest-lying lines of valence emission spectra. Using near-edge x-ray absorption and emission, we probe the electronic structure of Li 2 CO 3 . Our measurements are compared to first-principles calcula…

item.title: New implementation of mixed-reference spin-flip time-dependent density functional theory and application to molecules with variable diradical character and conical intersections
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
Mixed-reference spin-flip time-dependent density functional theory (MRSF-TDDFT) improves upon the original spin-flip TDDFT (SF-TDDFT) approach by expanding the configurational space of the response states via a mixed-reference reduced density matrix, specifically, an equal mixture of the density matrices from the M S = +1 and M S = −1 components of the lowest triplet state. MRSF-TDDFT improves the description of the spin-flip target states and the respective energy differences and eliminates the problem of spin-contamination that often spoils the description of higher-lying states in SF-TDDFT. This article presents the theoretical framework and details of a new implementation of MRSF-TDDFT in the Q-Chem software package. The implementation includes calculations of energies and properties,…

item.title: Visualizing electron flow at transition states by natural reaction orbitals
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
Transition-state analysis in quantum chemistry provides structural and energetic information but does not directly reveal how electron density is redistributed at the onset of bond reorganization. Although frontier-orbital theory is highly effective for predicting reactivity from reactant molecules, it is less suited to transition states, where bond-breaking and bond-forming processes are already underway. Here, we show that natural reaction orbital (NRO) analysis provides a response-based framework for directly visualizing electron flow at transition states. By extracting the dominant occupied-virtual mixing induced by nuclear displacement along the imaginary vibrational mode, NRO analysis reveals the electronic response that drives bond reorganization.
